description: Fork of exp511 (qk hardened to argmax TinyMHLut, nap=2/tph=1024). ONLY change: qk_lut param-matched reshape nap 2->3, tph 1024->512 (entries/table 2^nap*tph: 4*1024 = 8*512 = 4096, unchanged; total 89.39M, identical). A second point on the qk wide-shallow-vs-deep curve at fixed entry budget: exp508 nap=6/tph=64 (soft), exp511 nap=2/tph=1024 (argmax), exp512 nap=3/tph=512 (argmax). Tests the row-coverage sweet spot for hard-argmax qk: NAP=3 = 8 rows/table x 512 tables, every row sees ~1024 tokens/batch at bs=16 (vs NAP=2's 4 rows/2048 tokens, NAP=6's 64 starved rows). vs exp511, exp508 1.4840 (soft qk), exp475 1.4962 (all argmax ref).
